title: South Indian Chicken Curry (Instant Pot)

items.n: boneless chicken leg, skin and large fat trimmed, 3cm pieces, patted dry

steps.x: Set the Instant Pot to Sauté (Normal). Heat the oil, add cinnamon, cloves, cardamom and fennel. Stir 30 seconds until fragrant. Add curry leaves.
Add the onion and cook, stirring, until golden brown. This builds the base flavour, so don't rush it.
Add ginger-garlic paste and green chillies, stir 1 minute. Add tomato and cook, mashing with the spoon, until soft and jammy.
Add chilli, coriander and turmeric powder. Stir 30 seconds, adding a splash of the water if it sticks.
Add the chicken and salt. Stir 1-2 minutes to coat in the masala.
Pour in the water and scrape the bottom well. This prevents the Burn warning.
Lock the lid, valve to Sealing. Pressure Cook on High for 6 minutes. Natural release 5 minutes, then quick release.
Set to Sauté. Simmer uncovered until the gravy thickens. Stir in garam masala and coriander. Turn off.

notes: Thawed chicken holds water. Pat it dry, and simmer the gravy 2 minutes longer if it's watery.
Storage: cool within 2 hours, refrigerate airtight. Good for 3 days.
Reheat until steaming hot throughout. Add 1 tbsp water if the gravy has thickened.
